support.needHuman: Want to speak with a Care Coordinator?
support.description: Book a free consultation and our team will answer all your questions about our disability and aged care services.

items.q: What makes Riayah Plus different from regular home care agencies?
items.a: Unlike fragmented agencies where you must manage separate nurses and therapists, Riayah assigns a dedicated Care Coordinator who crafts a holistic Care Plan, synchronizes your entire clinical team, and keeps your family informed in one unified app.

items.q: How do you match clinicians and caregivers to my family member?
items.a: During the initial consultation, we assess your loved one's clinical requirements, personality preferences, schedule, and cultural context. Your coordinator handpicks vetted nurses, physiotherapists, and support specialists best suited for them.

items.q: Can care plans be adjusted as our family's needs change?
items.a: Yes, absolutely. The Riayah Care Plan is a living blueprint. Your coordinator conducts ongoing reviews and adjusts hours, therapy goals, and clinical visits as your loved one progresses or needs evolve.

items.q: What disability and aged care services are available at home?
items.a: We provide comprehensive home nursing, rehabilitation (physiotherapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy), assistance with daily living activities, companion care, respite support, and telehealth follow-ups.

items.q: How quickly can we start care after booking a consultation?
items.a: Once you complete the initial consultation, your coordinator can assess needs, finalize the individualized care plan, and begin scheduled visits within 24 to 48 hours.
